native_context: Regular-expression matching cost and bounded input control
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Regular-expression matching cost and bounded input control — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read the exact regex, flags/engine, caller-controlled subject or pattern, maximum length and call frequency. Trace reachability and timeouts at the actual consumer.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an isolated process with an explicit short timeout and small input ceiling. Compare a normal subject and a few bounded near-match lengths derived from the regex structure, recording engine/version and elapsed behavior. Stop at the first meaningful budget breach; no live-service load is needed.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A nested quantifier is a lead, not universal catastrophic cost. Engine optimization, bounded input and unreachable matching can defeat the hypothesis. A few timings do not establish an asymptotic proof.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use an equivalent safer expression/engine or appropriate input/work limits for the actual contract. Retest valid matches, nonmatches and the original expensive case under the same budget.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
